title: PAYE from First Principles: A Deep Dive with nrsR
text: Every month, millions Nigerian workers see line payslip labelled PAYE — money withheld paid. Employers legally responsible computing figure correctly, getting wrong means either short-changing employee -remitting theNigeria Revenue Service (NRS). nrsR exists make computation exact, reproducible, future-proof. vignette takes “PAYE?” way running payroll entire workforce — shows nrsR’s design means 2028 tax amendment cost one file edit, rewrite.

title: PAYE from First Principles: A Deep Dive with nrsR
text: PAYE (Pay---Earn) system income tax deducted source, spread across year rather paid one lump sum. Nigeria amount owed progressive: income sliced bands, band taxed rate. Two laws matter today:
code: list_tax_laws()   #>             key                                   description effective_from #> PITA       PITA              Personal Income Tax Act (legacy)     1993-01-01 #> NTA2025 NTA2025 Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (effective January 2026)     2026-01-01 #>         effective_to n_bands #> PITA      2025-12-31       6 #> NTA2025      current       6

title: PAYE from First Principles: A Deep Dive with nrsR
text: Meet Ngozi, Lagos product manager earning ₦1,624,734/month pays ₦1,800,000/year rent. December 2025 taxed old PITA regime. 1 January 2026 Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (NTA2025) takes effect — first ₦800,000 annual income becomes tax-free, old Consolidated Relief Allowance (CRA) disappears, newrent relief appears. Ngozi wants know: “take home less next year?” WithnrsR, doesn’t guess — computes worlds compares . story nrsR really story change: tax laws evolve, tool built evolution cheap.

title: PAYE from First Principles: A Deep Dive with nrsR
text: Think progressive tax like filling set stacked buckets. Income pours top. first bucket (first ₦800,000 NTA2025) tap set 0% — nothing drips tax. overflows, income spills next bucket, whose tap open wider (15%), . higher bucket, wider tap. never taxed top rate money — portion reaches bucket. tax_breakdown() shows exactly much landed bucket much dripped :

PAYE from First Principles: A Deep Dive with nrsR
text: Effective rate ≠ top band rate. Ngozi may touch 18% band, hereffective rate (tax ÷ gross) much lower lower buckets cheap free. Read effective_rate calc_paye(). Reliefs leverage. Pension (8%) rent relief directly shrink taxable income. Two people identical gross can owe different tax. NTA2025 helps lower earners . ₦800K tax-free floor removes low-income workers tax entirely — verify running small salary laws. Auto-dispatch removes human error. Passing law = "auto" means payroll always uses legally-correct law run date.

what: 8. Visual Analogy — the registry as a “law cartridge”
title: PAYE from First Principles: A Deep Dive with nrsR
text: Picture old games console. console calculation engine (calc_paye, calc_reliefs, .apply_bands) — never changes. tax law cartridge slot : PITA, NTA2025, one dayNTA2028. Swapping cartridge changes whole game (bands, rates, reliefs) without opening console. Adding future law = printing new cartridge (one list entry). console instantly plays : list_tax_laws(), compare_tax_laws(),calc_paye_batch() recognise automatically.

title: PAYE from First Principles: A Deep Dive with nrsR
text: Keep three models head: Stacked buckets → progressive bands; overflow reaches next tap. Console + cartridges → fixed engine, swappable law definitions. Funnel → gross goes top, reliefs subtracted, taxable income drops buckets, tax comes bottom. can picture three, understand PAYE nrsR architecture.

Edit R/law_registry.R . “Auto = accurate.” law = "auto" always picks right law date.

title: nrsR - Nigeria Revenue Service PAYE Toolkit
text: nrsR named Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS), replaced Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS) landmark 2025 tax reforms signed President Tinubu. package computes Nigerian Pay---Earn (PAYE) income tax using aversioned law registry architecture — future amendments require editing exactly one file zero changes calculation logic. Two design principles: One source truth. Every band, rate, relief, effective date lives .TAX_LAW_REGISTRY (R/law_registry.R). functions read , new tax law single list entry, rewrite. Law-agnostic engine. Passing different law key (law = "auto") automatically selects law’s bands rules — calculation code never changes.
